options: Free audit
Register as a participant
Support ticket in the participant portal
The Academy catalogue
pool.explanation: The free audit is the agency’s no-obligation review request. The participant sign-up and portal are for the creator program, and the Academy teaches rather than reviews a business.

pool.question: On Book a consultation, the times shown look three hours off from your meeting plans. What is the most likely cause?
options: Your device is set to a different time zone, because slots are shown in your browser’s time zone
The agency only offers calls in UK time
Slots are always shown in UTC
The call length changes by time zone
pool.explanation: The booking page groups free slots by day and shows them in the visitor’s own time zone, taken from the browser. A wrong device time zone shifts every slot.

pool.question: Your verification link says it has expired. What should you do?
options: Request a fresh link from the page or the resend form
Register again with another email address
Keep clicking the old link
Ask support to verify you by phone
pool.explanation: Verification links work once and expire after a while; the page lets you request a new one. A second account would be a duplicate, which the creator program rules forbid.

pool.question: Which details on the registration form directly affect campaigns and deadlines later? (Choose all that apply.)
options: Country
Time zone
Password strength
Display name colour
pool.explanation: Country decides which campaigns target you and the time zone is used for campaign deadlines and payout dates. Password strength protects the account but does not affect campaigns; there is no display name colour.

pool.question: You switch off "Email me about new campaigns and tips" in your profile. Which emails keep arriving?
options: Account, submission and payout emails
Only marketing emails
No emails at all
Only emails from brands
pool.explanation: The switch controls marketing email only. The profile page states that account, submission and payout emails are always sent.

pool.question: On the Notifications tab, the "New campaigns" row is ticked for email but you still get no emails about new campaigns. Why?
options: It is a marketing message, so email also needs the marketing switch turned on in your Profile tab
Email is locked off for everyone
You must add a WhatsApp number first
New campaign alerts are only shown on the Payouts page
pool.explanation: Marketing rows need two switches: the row itself and the marketing email opt-in on the Profile tab. The table reminds you of this under such rows.

pool.question: You created your account with Continue with Google and now want to sign in with your email address too. What do you do?
options: Open Profile, Security and use "Email me a link to set a password"
Disconnect Google first
Register a second account with the same email
Ask a friend to share their password
pool.explanation: Google-created accounts have no password; the Security page emails a link to set one. You cannot disconnect Google while it is your only sign-in method, and a second account is a duplicate.

pool.question: Which of these belong in a support ticket about a payout that looks too small? (Choose all that apply.)
options: The payout linked in the Related payout field
Dates and what you expected to receive
Your full bank account number so finance can check
Your account password
pool.explanation: Linking the payout and giving dates and expectations helps the team answer quickly. The ticket form warns never to share passwords or full bank details; payout details belong only on the Payout details tab.

pool.question: You read every lesson of a course on /learn without enrolling. What can you NOT do yet?
options: Take the final assessment and earn the certificate
Read the lessons
Try the knowledge checks in your browser
Read the lecture transcripts
pool.explanation: Lessons, transcripts and knowledge checks are open to everyone. Saved progress, the final assessment and certificates need a free enrolment.

Describe each filter in a message
Enrol your colleague in every course

options: You return to the course, the enrolment completes and lesson 1 opens
You must find the course and enrol again from scratch
An administrator must approve the enrolment
You are enrolled in every course in the catalogue

options: At least one lesson has not been marked complete
The assessment only opens on Mondays
You answered a knowledge check wrongly
Lectures must be watched at normal speed
pool.explanation: The assessment unlocks only when every lesson is marked complete. Knowledge checks are practice, not a gate, and speed does not matter.

pool.question: Do knowledge-check answers count towards your certificate?

Yes, they are averaged with the exam
Yes, but only for video lessons
Only if you answer within one minute

pool.question: An exam question says "Choose all that apply" and three options are correct. You tick two correct options and nothing else. What score does the question get?

Two thirds of a mark
Full marks, because nothing wrong was ticked
Half a mark
pool.explanation: Grading gives no partial credit: a question is correct only when your selection equals the correct set exactly.

pool.question: Your internet drops for ten minutes during a 15-minute attempt. You had answered six questions before it dropped. What happens?
options: The server clock kept running; when time runs out, your saved answers are graded
